goal: Colour-only test on the same sheet and seeds as the weight-wording job: teal #48C2C3 fur (not seafoam), a pale-cyan chest and belly (mint #D0FFFA in the style guide; not cream), a pale-cyan hip patch, and blue navy #2A4365 markings (not near-black).
why: BASE: female-raccoon-001-ipadapter-weight-wording (Josh: off-track). Only the colour wording changes; IP-Adapter stays at 0.8 and the seeds, model, LoRA, size, steps, CFG and sampler are as before. '(teal fur:1.3), (turquoise fur:1.1)' sit early; 'mint' became 'pale cyan' so the green-leaning word stops bleeding onto the fur (chest and belly 1.1, hip patch 1.1, muzzle now 'white'); '(vivid colors:1.1)' plus negative 'muted colors, desaturated, pastel colors' push toward the saturated teal; negative '(green fur:1.2), mint green, (black fur:1.1), purple' and one 'navy blue' on the mask push the markings to blue. JUDGE: fur near #48C2C3, chest pale cyan not cream, markings blue not black, pale cyan hip patch in back view. Leaks (swatches, busts, head studies) from the reference are expected at 0.8 and are not judged here; the next job tackles them. Head size is not tested.
